evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a leaf-head spear from front and three-quarter (head, winged socket, banded grip, butt cap all break the outline); top view is a dot as expected for a spear, symmetry_error X/Y 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big leaf head, medium gold socket + wings + butt cap + collar, small ink/teal grip bands; long plain haft between socket and grip is the only quiet stretch.
evidence.V3: Proportions only partly stylised: head is modest against an 8.2-stud haft that stays thin and straight; wings are chunky slabs while the rest stays near-realistic, so the stylisation is uneven.
evidence.V4: Inconsistent edges: socket collar, butt ring and wing tops carry chamfers that catch light, but the blade edges read soft/rounded with no crisp bevel line and the wings are flat paddles with a single bevel.
evidence.V5: Minor issues: small pinched notch at the very blade tip, visible low-segment faceting on the socket cone and butt cap in the studio close-ups; gate reports 204 cross-shell overlaps (intentional penetrations, not visible z-fighting).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, teal haft in two values, ink bands, steel blade; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue family cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1980 tris vs weapon target 2500 / ceiling 4000: under target.
evidence.V8: Matches kit: single white vertex-colour material, gold/ink/steel + one hue in up to 3 values, chamfered rings similar to the kit anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle at grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pinched/notched vertex cluster at the blade tip
Visible faceting on socket cone and butt cap (low cylinder segment count)
top_fixes: Push the stylisation: larger, wider leaf head and a slightly thicker haft so the spear reads confidently at 64 px
Give the blade a consistent edge bevel (crisp chamfer along both edges) matching the ~0.045-stud kit chamfers on the rings
Clean the blade tip into a single clean point and raise segment count / add smoothing on the socket cone and butt cap
Shape the wings (taper or curve) instead of flat paddles so they match the head's form language
